create_BatchedDecodeContext: create a BatchedDecodeContext dataclass instance with batch_size, seq_lens, and layer_caches for batched decode
set_context_batched_decode: set the BatchedDecodeContext on thread-local storage before calling attention wrapper
get_context_batched_decode: get the current BatchedDecodeContext from thread-local storage
clear_context_batched_decode: clear the BatchedDecodeContext from thread-local storage
build_MLXAttentionWrapper: build an MLXAttentionWrapper that wraps an mlx-lm Attention module for batched decode with per-request RoPE and SDPA
